text.description_html:
Acorn AKYJP, Bullet Shutter Catch

The Bullet Shutter Catch is made of brass and stainless steel. The bullet is solid brass, the catch is stainless steel. Bullet catches are small enough to remain unobtrusive on your shutters. They are designed to hold open window shutters and are easy to use by simply pushing the shutter open until the bullet is secured into the clip type catch. Packaged with bullet, catch and stainless steel screws.

Features and Specifications of the Acorn AKZJP Window Shutter Holder:

  • Bullet Diameter: 9/16"
  • Bullet Length: 1-1/4"
  • Bullet Material: Solid Brass
  • Catch Material: Stainless Steel
  • Comes packaged with 1 Bullet, 1 catch, plastic anchor for brick mount, and 2 stainless steel screws.

Sold Individually
